name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: Many small numbers as a field of cells, each as dark as its value.
use: A pattern across many values: activity by day, load by hour. Each cell carries its number as --value and says it in its own text as a full phrase. Label the list with what is measured and over what period.

instead.when: There are a few numbers and two of them must be told apart
The exact numbers are read and compared
The days are there to pick a date from

classes.name: heatmap
classes.description: The list: cells fill columns of --heatmap-rows from the top

classes.name: heatmap-lg
classes.description: 20px cells with a 4px gap; the default is 12px with 3px

classes.name: heatmap-cell
classes.description: One value; set --value in its style and say it in its text, which is kept for assistive technology and not drawn

properties.name: --value
properties.description: The cell's number; the stylesheet reads 0 when it is not set

properties.name: --heatmap-max
properties.description: The value that is full ink

properties.name: --heatmap-color
properties.description: The ink at the top of the scale

example:
1. Mon 24 Aug: 5 deployments
  2. Tue 25 Aug: 6 deployments
  3. Wed 26 Aug: 6 deployments
  4. Thu 27 Aug: 3 deployments
  5. Fri 28 Aug: 2 deployments
  6. Sat 29 Aug: 1 deployment
  7. Sun 30 Aug: 0 deployments
